projects.name: Image Captioning Transformer
projects.description: An end-to-end deep learning model that generates natural language captions for images using a Transformer-based architecture with CNN encoder and attention mechanism. Trained on COCO dataset with BLEU score evaluation.

projects.name: Amazon Clone
projects.description: A full-stack e-commerce web application replicating core Amazon features including product listings, user authentication, shopping cart, order management, and a responsive UI.

projects.name: Weather App
projects.description: A clean, real-time weather application that fetches live data from a public weather API. Displays temperature, humidity, wind speed, and a 5-day forecast with an animated UI.

projects.name: Notes Management System
projects.description: A full-featured notes application with CRUD operations, rich text editing, tagging, search functionality, and user authentication. Built with a Java Spring Boot backend and React frontend.

projects.name: Task Manager
projects.description: A productivity-focused task management application with drag-and-drop Kanban board, priority levels, due date reminders, and progress tracking. Built with Python and Streamlit.

projects.name: AI Tic-Tac-Toe
projects.description: An intelligent Tic-Tac-Toe game featuring an unbeatable AI opponent powered by the Minimax algorithm with Alpha-Beta pruning. Includes multiple difficulty levels and an animated game board.

projects.name: Rule-Based Chatbot
projects.description: An intelligent rule-based chatbot that uses pattern matching and a knowledge base to handle FAQs, provide information, and guide users through common workflows. Built with Python and NLTK.

projects.name: Browser-Based Chat Application
projects.description: A real-time browser-based chat application supporting multiple rooms, user presence, typing indicators, and message history using WebSockets.
